name: EOD 2026-06-05
body:
> Eod · 2026-06-05

AEO/GEO/SEO audits plus schema and title fixes across three clients.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Full audit of 114 location pages.
- Made 7 Emergency Plumbing titles/metas unique per city; fixed 6 wrong-city bleed pages (Fixture Installation, Pipe Lining, Sewer Line Repair).
- Trimmed 38 over-length titles to 60 characters or less and removed leftover `%%page%%` tags.
- H1 fixes on 27 pages (hero set to H1 on 22, duplicate H1s demoted on 5 Water Softener pages) via a `wp eval` JSON round-trip, verified live.
- Removed mismatched FAQ schema from 10 General Plumbing pages (no visible FAQ).
- Added Service schema across city-service pages with a new mu-plugin `summit-service-schema.php`.
- Added alt text to the 3 images missing it; backups, Yoast indexables cleared, cache purged.

# Alphalete Trenchless
See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Audit of 133 location pages; wrong-city scan clean.
- Documented gaps: FAQ schema on 18 pages, duplicate H1, Hydro Jetting schema, template grammar bug. mu-plugin v1.2.0 installed, FAQ layer not deployed.

# Pipeliners
See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Read-only audit of 37 city pages found OTTO deploying the wrong "Course" schema.
- With Scott's approval: Metasync test post set to noindex; Course removed and Service schema deployed on 30 city pages in OTTO. Live check confirmed Course gone.

# Deliverables
- Summit and Alphalete audit reports and CSVs, `pipeliners-otto-schema-fix.md`, `monday-todo-pending-tasks.csv` (see [Monday Task Lists 2026-06-05](lib:brain-monday-task-lists-2026-06-05)).

# Follow-ups
- Summit: General Plumbing FAQ (10 pages), 8 missing service-area pages.
- Alphalete: FAQ schema (18 pages), duplicate H1, template grammar cleanup.
